scope: Paired single-bundle study of routed/assigned target observations plus a monotone progress potential, against a dimension-matched masked control with the unchanged potential. Same parents, training stream, budget and 100 development layouts as the completed EXP32/EXP33 arms.
authorization: User asked for the measured routing and coverage deficits to be fixed. Code, tests, certificates and GPU preflight are autonomous; the formal 500K x 3 seed run is not.
transition_unit: one environment control step, not individual robot samples
comparability: Both arms share physics, reward terms other than the potential, parents, PPO settings, 512-transition rollouts, 500K budget, training layout stream 1900000000 and validation layouts 940000000-940000099, which are the same layouts EXP32 and EXP33 used. The arms differ only in whether the appended 36 target features are computed and which progress potential is used; the 76-feature prefix and all other rewards are bit-identical, which is asserted by tests/test_mca_routed_targets.py.
task_limit: Controlled in-vitro goal-conditioned ideal-actuator simulation with perfect state. All object positions randomized on fixed MCA anatomy. Soft overlap costs, not hard collision physics. Diagnostic clearance feasibility is not collision-free policy performance or hardware verification.
dashboard_message: EXP34 MASKED_POTENTIAL 纯RL：屏蔽路由观测+单调势函数，用于拆分观测与势函数效应，物理与随机化不变，每seed50万步。尚无改善结论。
study_stage: Matched 500K extension of EXP32/EXP33 on the same 100 development layouts; not a new generalization test.
bundled_variables: Two changes move together on purpose: at 355 training episodes per 500K-step run the seed spread (6/26/42 percent in EXP31 control) cannot resolve either alone. The allocation is only observed and the potential stays a pure state function, so neither introduces a controller or changes the success definition.
